        long w = fs.nextLong(), m = fs.nextLong();
        
        if (w <= 3) {
            System.out.println("YES");
            return;
        }

        List<Long> powers = new ArrayList<>();
        long val = 1;
        while (val <= 2_000_000_000L) {
            powers.add(val);
            val *= w;
        }

        int n = powers.size();
        int[] digits = new int[n];
        Arrays.fill(digits, -1);

        long currentSum = 0;

        boolean found = false;

        outerLoop:

                    }
                    break;

                digits[idx] = -1;

                idx++;

            }
        }

        System.out.println(found ? "YES" : "NO");
